-- w/ok/ok.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

func pick[T any](v T) int {
	_ = v
	const switch T {
	case int:
		return 1
	}
	return 0
	comptime.Error("unsupported")
	return 0
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(pick[int](0))
}

-- w/bad/bad.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)
func pick[T any](v T) int {
	_ = v
	const switch T {
	case int:
		return 1
	}
	return 0
	comptime.Error("unsupported")
	return 0
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(pick[string]("s"))
}
